summary: Stop-hook handoff reminder now scopes to the current session: it fires only when the session transcript shows an Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit on an engine file, so a session on a branch carrying another session's engine changes is no longer nagged. Falls back to the old branch-level check when the transcript is unreadable.
validation: python -m unittest discover -s tools/hooks: all pass, incl. 3 new cases (inherited changes with no session edit, session edit still reminds, unreadable transcript falls back).
remaining: Edits made only through Bash are invisible to the check. None otherwise; ready for review.
